metadata.title: नलिन सोरेन: झारखंड में 1932 खातियानी लागू हो | Nalin Soren: A very popular tribal leader
metadata.description: Jharkhand Mukti Morcha’s (JMM) Shikaripara MLA Nalin Soren is much respected tribal of Santal pargana. In the year 2020 he received citation of Best MLA Award from Jharkhand Governor Droupadi Murmu during 20th foundation day of Jharkhand assembly. He is a down to earth and popular leader in his area.
